name: Aten Ra, Solar Law King
loreTies: Aten Ra embodies solar creator-kingship, Ma’at judgment, sacred throne law, and renewal radiance within The Solar Dominion of Khepra.
The Sun-Scale Gate allows this deity to enter Ascension-era dungeon routes without collapsing the individuality of other Realms.
Aten Ra culture, symbols, weapons, and divine law shape every ability, artifact, silhouette, and combat choice.
shortBackstory: Aten Ra, Solar Law King, is a playable god in Mythos Gates: Ascension. Aten Ra is the true source-realm divinity behind the mythology — solar creator-kingship, Ma’at judgment, sacred throne law, and renewal radiance. Ascension expands divine power during the current Gate crisis; it does not turn a mortal into a god.

chapters.title: Divine Origin
chapters.text: Aten Ra is not a mortal hero inspired by myth. Aten Ra is the actual god recognized by Aten Ra source culture, born from the supernatural laws of The Solar Dominion of Khepra. Their domain — solar creator-kingship, Ma’at judgment, sacred throne law, and renewal radiance — determines their symbols, weapons, posture, combat instincts, and relationship to sacred authority.

chapters.title: Faction Bond
chapters.text: Within Aten Ra, Aten Ra expresses the civilization rather than merely representing it. Their visual identity must carry the materials, beauty standards, divine symbols, and sacred rules of The Solar Dominion of Khepra. Their gameplay role, Defender, must grow from mythology first and mechanics second.

chapters.title: Mythos Gate Wound
chapters.text: During the Ascension era, Aten Ra can interact with The Sun-Scale Gate because divine beings are intrinsically connected to their Realms. The Gate does not become a simple teleportation portal; it is a mysterious boundary where separate mythological realities become traversable. Aten Ra understands some rites of crossing, but not the complete origin of the Mythos Gates.

chapters.title: Dungeon Role
chapters.text: When selected by the player, Aten Ra enters the dungeon alone as one god or goddess against multiple enemies. No army follows. No squad shares control. Every room, trap, shrine, relic, elite, and boss encounter must test how solar creator-kingship, Ma’at judgment, sacred throne law, and renewal radiance survives pressure from creatures, rival Realm laws, and unstable Gate conditions.

chapters.title: Ascension Conflict
chapters.text: Ascension is the current story arc, not the permanent end-state of the Mythos Gates universe. For Aten Ra, Ascension means restoration, awakening, evolution, or expansion of existing divine power. Their personal conflict is to recover strength without reducing Aten Ra mythology into raw fuel for the crisis.

relationshipHooks: Faction witnesses interpret how Aten Ra crosses The Sun-Scale Gate.
Rival deities challenge the limits of cross-Realm travel.
Dungeon lore pickups reveal Gate mystery without resolving the full origin.
developmentStatus: Playable deity backstory aligned to Mythos Gates identity, one-deity dungeon runs, current Ascension arc, and preserved Lore Codex canon.
visualCanon: Colossal living solar judge with readable divine anatomy, an Aten sun-disc crown radiating subtle hand-like rays, electrum wesekh collar fused into chest armor, Ma’at feather balance seams, white-gold noon aura, black-lapis shadow insets, and pylon-shaped shield forearms. Must feel older than Egyptian royalty, not a statue, robot, sarcophagus, or pyramid body.
title: Solar Law King

mythosGatesCanon.identityRule: Aten Ra is the actual god of Aten Ra source mythology, never a mortal hero or generic champion.
mythosGatesCanon.arcRule: Ascension restores, awakens, evolves, or expands existing divine power; it does not make the character a god for the first time.
mythosGatesCanon.mysteryRule: The backstory may reveal how this deity interacts with the Mythos Gates, but must not resolve the full origin of the Gates.
